entities.summary: Gabriel de Souza Bonfim is a Brazilian mixed martial artist and former boxer. He currently competes in the welterweight division of the Ultimate Fighting Championship. He previously competed in Legacy Fighting Alliance, where he is a former LFA Welterweight Champion. As of February 10, 2026, he is #10 in the UFC welterweight rankings.
